subject: mathematics
title: Solving simple equations
summary: Find the unknown number by doing the same thing to both sides.

lesson.text: An equation says two things are equal, like x + 3 = 10. Solving it means finding the number x stands for.

Think of a weighing scale. Whatever you do to one side, do to the other, and it stays balanced. Use the opposite operation to get x on its own: subtract to undo +, add to undo −, divide to undo ×, multiply to undo ÷.

lesson.title: x + 7 = 15
steps: Undo + 7 by subtracting 7 from both sides.

lesson.title: x ÷ 4 = 3
steps: Undo ÷ 4 by multiplying both sides by 4.

lesson.title: I think of a number, multiply it by 3 and add 4. The answer is 19.

lesson.text: Always check by putting your answer back into the equation. It takes ten seconds and catches most mistakes.

questions.explanation: Add 6 to both sides: x = 9 + 6 = 15. Check: 15 − 6 = 9 ✓
Subtract 2x from both sides: 3x − 4 = 11. Add 4: 3x = 15. Divide by 3: x = 5. Check: 21 = 21 ✓

questions.prompt: Bayo has some money. After spending ₦250 he has ₦400 left. Which equation shows this?
questions.explanation: Start with m, take away ₦250, and ₦400 is left: m − 250 = 400. So m = ₦650.
